key: Remember to stock up before leaving the city! It can sometimes be a long way between PokéMarts out there.
en: Remember to stock up before leaving the city! It can sometimes be a long way between PokéMarts out there.
ja: 街を出る前に　補給を忘れずにね! 外はショップとショップの間が　遠いこともあるから

key: You look a lot more traveled than you did last time I saw you around here.
en: You look a lot more traveled than you did last time I saw you around here.
ja: 前に会ったときより　ずいぶん旅慣れた顔に　なったね

key: You've probably got some great stories by now, right?
en: You've probably got some great stories by now, right?
ja: もう　すごい冒険話の　ひとつやふたつ　あるんじゃない?

key: Oh, these vitamin drinks really pack a punch!
en: Oh, these vitamin drinks really pack a punch!
ja: いやあ　この栄養ドリンクは　効くねぇ!

key: In fact, if you ask me, I'd say they boost EVs, by...
en: In fact, if you ask me, I'd say they boost EVs, by...
ja: 俺に言わせりゃ　上がる努力値の量は　そうだな……
うーん　味から判断すると?
一本で　努力値32ってとこだ!

key: No doubt about it-- I can tell for sure by the stinging on my tongue.
en: No doubt about it-- I can tell for sure by the stinging on my tongue.
ja: 間違いない――舌のしびれ具合で　はっきり分かる

key: And they don't cap out at 100 either.
en: And they don't cap out at 100 either.
ja: しかも　100で頭打ちにも　ならない

key: This is the fifth floor: Mid-tier General Needs and Vitamins.
en: This is the fifth floor: Mid-tier General Needs and Vitamins.
ja: ここは5階　中級の生活用品と　栄養ドリンク売り場です
